name: Antes todo esto era campo
summary: In a secluded town where local legends dictate reality, repeated as the sole truth by its inhabitants, a young man embarks on challenges far beyond his comfort zone to confront the monsters that populate these stories. These tales appear to be connected through the actions of a malevolent corporation that secretly controls the entire town. The young man finds himself at a crossroads: cling to these socially accepted worldviews or find the courage to unlearn his prejudices.
